notes.note: Added the boundary gate's rule as implemented now: it refuses updater/process grants in every JSON file under capabilities/ and permissions/ and in app.security.capabilities of Tauri configs, and refuses any non-JSON file there; the TOML/JSON5 lexer was removed.

Checked against desktop_update.rs: a startup restore reports checking (state() while restoring), a Check pressed then is refused, and a drop guard ends the restore even if verification panics. Updated the guide's restore sentence from idle to checking.

Reworded the refusal timing after reading publish-release.yml: the host-stream manifest is attached in an earlier step, so the refusal at Assemble and validate comes before the updater channel is uploaded, not before anything is.
